scope: Reuse the same D-Bus model binding in the existing native field host, without duplicating controls or rebuilding browsers

implementation.binding: One MenuBinding implementation serves standalone host.py and inherited-role MenuBroker.
implementation.native_components: Existing NSApplication/NSMenu/NSMenuItem and field editor implementations remain in GNUstep/NativeUI.
implementation.keyboard: Exported shortcut metadata feeds native key matching; field keys use native editing. No application command-name or key-binding table is added.
implementation.scheduling: Key command callbacks enqueue an opaque token and return. Outer helper tick resolves and sends the real exporter action after the native input RPC reply.
implementation.loop: GLib public prepare/query descriptors and deadlines join existing native source descriptors. Nested menu pumping services descriptors without native event reentry.
implementation.authority: Private inherited SEQPACKET role supplies compositor window metadata; D-Bus unique owner PID must match. Focus/key input requires owning client and authenticated notifier PID/pidfd plus browser ancestry.
implementation.lifecycle: Binding stop invalidates in-flight generations and queued commands; idle close destroys native menu and drops subscriptions. Menu removal/owner exit preserve shared helper.

remaining: Production authenticated shell window/focus selection, registrar and helper lifecycle; fixture currently binds one owned browser window.
Special-key and multi-chord metadata, ambiguous rebuilt siblings, visible-branch updates, icons and torn-off menus.
Remaining browser/frontend controls and dialogs, IME, accessibility and mixed scaling.
Chrome, Vivaldi and Firefox derivatives; complete GTK, Qt/KDE and other application coverage.
